import csv

best = {}
with open("contacts.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    next(reader)
    for row in reader:
        if not row:
            continue
        name = row[0].strip()
        email = row[1].strip().lower()
        created = row[2].strip()
        # strict < keeps the first-appearing row on ties
        if email not in best or created < best[email][2]:
            best[email] = (name, email, created)

rows = sorted(best.values(), key=lambda t: (t[2], t[1]))

with open("clean.csv", "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(["name", "email", "created"])
    writer.writerows(rows)
